Chapter 238: Chapter 2: Twenty Years Later (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 238: Chapter 2: Twenty Years Later (Please Subscribe)

This world’s cultivation system, from weak to strong, is divided into—

Qi Refinement, Foundation Establishment, Golden Core, Nascent Soul, Divinity Transformation, Refine Void.

Lin Yuan had no Spirit Root and could not inhale and exhale the nature’s spiritual energy.

Naturally, he could not follow the Immortal Cultivation System.

But for the Martial Tao Cultivation System, having a Spirit Root was not necessary.

The Martial Tao Cultivation System established by Lin Yuan had a low threshold, especially for someone like him who had evolved the Martial Tao to the Sixth Rank.

...

It was a piece of cake.

Exhale.

Inhale.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

Internal energy circulated within him.

A moment later,

Lin Yuan opened his eyes and took out a bottle of elixirs.

He poured out a pellet and swallowed it.

Once the elixir entered his body, it immediately transformed into a raging flow of blood energy.

Continuously forming the ‘Inner Qi’ of the early stages of Martial Tao.

The differences between Immortal Path and the initial stages of Martial Tao,

lay in Immortal Path requiring the refinement of the essence of nature into one’s own internal energy.

The essence of nature referred to here is the nature’s spiritual energy.

Whereas Martial Tao involves refining the essence of oneself, transforming one’s own internal energy.

Efficiency-wise, refining the essence of nature in Immortal Path is naturally faster.

After all, nature’s spiritual energy is infinite and inexhaustible.

Of course, its shortcomings were also very clear.

That was being too dependent on nature’s spiritual energy.

If one were to lose access to that natural energy, or were in a place devoid of it,

it’s supposed that the Immortal Cultivation System would be cut off.

While the early stages of the Martial Tao Cultivation System focus on refining one’s own essence,

no matter in what world, as long as one still possesses vitality, one can cultivate the Martial Tao.

Moreover, cultivating to deeper levels in Martial Tao also enables one to forcibly inhale and exhale the spiritual energy of nature.

This so-called spiritual energy of nature is merely a form of energy after all.

It’s just that cultivators of the Immortal Path attract spiritual energy with the Spirit Root within them, whereas Martial Tao cultivators forcibly devour it.

Half a day later,

after consuming dozens of elixirs that enhance vitality, Lin Yuan stepped into the Second Layer.

The Second Layer of Martial Tao is equivalent to the Foundation Establishment Stage of the Immortal Path.

“It’s about time.”

Lin Yuan restrained his vitality and concealed the aura of the Second Layer of Martial Tao.

In this world, which is a great world of Immortal Path, if he were to suddenly display previously unseen talents or techniques,

Even without signs of ‘Seizure’, it would attract the attention of others, especially with such a profound background.

With an external grandfather at the level of an Ancient Saint of Refining Void.

It’s better to be cautious and careful about his actions.

Lin Yuan didn’t want his abnormal performance to lead his parents to take him to his grandfather for inspection, which might end up with him being kept by this Ancient Saint.

“I need to create a secret technique that blocks the detection of Divine Sense…”

Lin Yuan fell into contemplation.

In the world of Immortal Tao, detection techniques are primarily based on Divine Sense.

As long as the detection of Divine Sense can be obstructed, it essentially means that outsiders would have a hard time actively realizing Lin Yuan’s true power.

“Divine Sense…”

Lin Yuan pondered repeatedly.

Divine Sense is a certain application of the soul’s power; to block the perception of Divine Sense, one must similarly use the soul’s power to ‘prevent’ it.

With Lin Yuan’s exceptional talent and having multiple evolution paths from the Main World, including those involving the soul,

He only took a few days.

To create a secret technique targeted at the probing of Divine Sense.

This technique, utilizing one’s own soul’s power, forms a special barrier that instantly assimilates when the Divine Sense of other cultivators comes probing, thereby achieving the effect of shielding.

“Not bad, not bad.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

Upon activating this secret technique, in combination with his own realm, unless an Ancient Saint of Refining Void came personally and repeatedly inspected Lin Yuan directly, the abnormality could not be discovered.

If Lin Yuan could recover to the Fourth or Fifth Rank, even an Ancient Saint wouldn’t be able to discover anything problematic as long as he meticulously checked multiple layers inward and outward.

Two months later,

Lin Yuan was in the middle of secluded cultivation.

Suddenly,

At this moment,

The maid Chunhua hurriedly came outside.

“Young Master, Your older brother and second sister have come to see you.”

“I understand,” Lin Yuan stopped his cultivation and went out.

The ‘older brother and second sister’ mentioned by Chunhua

Were naturally Lin Yuan’s older brother and second sister.

The three had a good relationship, with the older brother and second sister taking great care of Lin Yuan.

Previously, when Lin Yuan was living in Mount Morality Immortal,

One of the reasons no one dared to provoke him

Was not only because of the background of his parents and grandfather,

But also because all disciples of Immortal Sect who provoked Lin Yuan

Were somehow beaten up several times by the older brother and second sister.

Over time, when disciples of Immortal Sect saw Lin Yuan, they couldn’t help but tremble, fearing they might be beaten if they made a mistake.

After all,

If other disciples beat you,

You could still reason with them, at worst go to the Enforcement Hall of the Immortal Sect.

But if Lin Yuan’s older brother and second sister beat you, then you could only swallow your grievances.

After all, their background was clear.

Would the cultivators of the Immortal Sect’s Enforcement Hall dare to truly punish the grandchildren of the Ancient Saint who were at the Sect Leader level?

Even if the Immortal Sect Leader emphasized many times that the cultivators of the Enforcement Hall must act impartially and must not engage in any favoritism,

But who would dare to truly be ‘impartial’?

“Little brother.”

“Little brother.”

Lin Yuan had not yet reached the front hall,

when he heard the voices of his older brother and second sister calling him.

“Older brother, second sister,”

Lin Yuan greeted.

“Hahaha, little brother, you look well,”

“Tell me, who dared to show off in your presence, I’ll make him suffer for a year,”

“A year isn’t enough, at least three years,”

said the older brother and second sister with a smile.

“Hahaha, it’s okay, no need for such trouble,”

Lin Yuan waved his hand.

Wuji, by nature, is not a bad person and doesn’t dwell on things.

Otherwise, he wouldn’t have let his parents send him away willingly.

Lin Yuan looked at his older brother and second sister in front of him.

The older brother was a tall and burly man with a very approachable smile.

It was said that the older brother had Metal Attribute Heavenly Spirit Root Talent and followed the path of a Sword Cultivator. He was powerful enough to rank among the top three of the Nascent Soul Layer in Mount Morality Immortal.
